## Performance Analysis

Here is the breakdown of the benchmark metrics:

| Metric | Baseline | Optimized | Speedup |
|---|---|---|---|
| Page Load | 2.4s | 0.8s | 3.0x |
| Memory Usage | 140MB | 65MB | 2.1x |
| CPU Idle | 45% | 85% | +40% |

Key takeaways:
- Main thread latency was reduced significantly
- Heap memory usage stayed below the target threshold

Here is the calculation script used:

```python
def calculate_speedup(baseline, current):
    return baseline / current
```

> Note: All tests ran on Chrome 120 in isolated environment.
